Solidarity of Steel#000.src: That's what we call the {p} sewers and waterworks. Maze of pipes and brickwork, some of it old old. Vagrants and criminals been settling there for years.
Solidarity of Steel#000.dst: {p} の下水道と水道施設をそう呼ぶんだ。パイプと煉瓦の迷路で、すごく古い所もある。浮浪者や犯罪者が何年も住みついてる。

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: You need to pack something that will help Aihan sleep, something to remind her of home, and something to entertain her at the station.
Solidarity of Steel#002.dst: Aihan のために荷物を詰めよう。眠るのに役立つ物、故郷を思い出す物、駅で退屈しのぎになる物だ。

Solidarity of Steel#003.src: Wh-what?! H-how did you fit my whole m-mattress in here? Was... was there not anything smaller?
Solidarity of Steel#003.dst: な、何！？ど、どうやって私のマ、マットレスを丸ごと入れたの？も…もっと小さい物はなかったの？

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#004.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} の外で仲間と合流する。

Solidarity of Steel#005.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#005.dst: …これで全員ね。よかった。みんな無事で。あの後だから、確信がなくて…
Solidarity of Steel#005.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#006.dst: さっきのこと、無視するつもりか？
Solidarity of Steel#006.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#008.dst: Zhiraok の祝福…自分を蘇らせる力を与えるの。ただ、少し時間がかかるけど。
Solidarity of Steel#008.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#009.dst: 逃げる望みを残すには、私が…彼を殺すしかなかった。
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#010.dst: とにかく、全員そろったわ！もうすぐ協力者と会う。そうすれば安全よ、でも…
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#012.dst: 少し時間があるわね。Roughworks に来て数日経ったけど、どう思う？
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#013.dst: そうでしょう？ずっと騒がしくて、窮屈で。なのに…私にはどこか懐かしいの。
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#014.dst: 懐かしい？ここが？うるさい工場とだだっ広い街のどこが懐かしいんだ？
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#016.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#016.dst: ぼ、僕も今回は Rex に賛成！こ、ここに長くい、いたくないよ。すごく…煙たいし。
Solidarity of Steel#016.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#017.dst: 確かに {p} ほど…清潔ではありませんね。朝露の香りが恋しくなりそうです！
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#018.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#018.dst: はいはい、言いたいことは今のうちに。協力者に会ったら Roughworks の悪口は控えてね…第一印象は良くしたいの。
Solidarity of Steel#018.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#019.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#019.dst: 実際に住まなきゃいけないなら、そうは思わないさ。
Solidarity of Steel#019.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#021.dst: 何だよ！？ここの連中だってほとんど同意するさ！
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#022.dst: ぼ、僕も今回は Rex に賛成かな！ここにす、住むなんて想像できないよ。すごく…煙たいし。
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#023.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#023.dst: 確かに {p} ほど…清潔ではありませんね。朝露の香りが恋しくなりそうです！
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#024.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#024.dst: はいはい、言いたいことは今のうちに。協力者に会ったら Roughworks の悪口は控えてね…相手が同意するかは別として。
Solidarity of Steel#024.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#025.dst: とにかく、正午に街で会う約束なの。{p} は昼間はたいてい人がいないから。
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#026.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#026.dst: え？昼間に人がいない？そ、それって変じゃない？
Solidarity of Steel#026.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#027.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#027.dst: Roughworks の人々の暮らしは、仕事一色なのよ。日の出に働き始めて、日没に終わる。だから、待ちましょう…
Solidarity of Steel#027.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
Solidarity of Steel#029.dst: えっと、ここでは時間の読み方が違う…とか？それとも私たちが―
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#031.dst: こんにちは、Quill。顔を合わせるのは久しぶりね。
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#032.src: Indeed, indeed... I hope your journey to cross to the Roughworks wasn't too difficult.
Solidarity of Steel#032.dst: まったくだ…Roughworks まで渡ってくる旅が大変でなかったならいいが。
Solidarity of Steel#032.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Could have been better, could have been worse. We expected difficulties going in.
Solidarity of Steel#033.dst: 良くも悪くもなかったわ。困難は覚悟の上だったから。
Solidarity of Steel#033.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#034.src: I see... You'll have to tell me more later. Now, which of you is the cursed one? I'd like a look at you.
Solidarity of Steel#034.dst: なるほど…詳しくは後で聞かせてくれ。さて、呪われし者はどの子かね？顔を見せておくれ。
Solidarity of Steel#034.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#035.src: Mmhm! So you're the one, eh? What I'd heard in correspondence had me thinking you'd be different than us. Seems like I was right!
Solidarity of Steel#035.dst: ほう！君がそうか。手紙を読んで、我々とは違うだろうと思っていたが。どうやら当たりだったな！
Solidarity of Steel#035.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#036.src: There's a look in your eyes, something to your gait. In all my years I've seen quite a lot, and everything that shouts "promise" is there in you.
Solidarity of Steel#036.dst: その目つき、その歩き方。長年多くを見てきたが、「将来有望」と叫ぶものが全部君にある。
Solidarity of Steel#036.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#037.src: Ha! Yes, yes, I suppose that would be the correct response to that question. You'd do well to stick to that script.
Solidarity of Steel#037.dst: はは！そうそう、その質問にはそう答えるのが正解だろうな。その台本を守るといい。
Solidarity of Steel#037.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#038.src: But Syndra has already written much about you in our correspondence. No need to be shy.
Solidarity of Steel#038.dst: だが Syndra が手紙で君のことをたくさん書いてくれた。遠慮はいらんよ。
Solidarity of Steel#038.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#039.src: Blessed, cursed... They're two sides of the same coin, in my eyes. I've seen my fair share of both in my time leading this group, heh heh...
Solidarity of Steel#039.dst: 祝福も呪いも…私に言わせれば同じコインの裏表だ。この組織を率いてきて、どちらも十分見てきたよ、へへ…
Solidarity of Steel#039.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#040.src: I see no reason not to celebrate differences, and what better difference could there be?
Solidarity of Steel#040.dst: 違いは祝うべきだと思うし、これ以上に素晴らしい違いがあるかね？
Solidarity of Steel#040.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#041.src: ... Ah, we'll have more time to speak later. We'd best make our way down to the station, we can sort out arrangements there-
Solidarity of Steel#041.dst: …ああ、話す時間は後でもある。まずは駅へ下りよう、段取りはそこで決めれば―
Solidarity of Steel#041.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#042.src: Hey, hey! We're leaving before we even get our introductions in? Why'd we even come here then, man?
Solidarity of Steel#042.dst: おいおい！自己紹介もしないで行っちまうのか？じゃあ何のために来たんだよ？
Solidarity of Steel#042.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#043.src: Yes, Yuman, why did we come here? You're the one who dragged us all along.
Solidarity of Steel#043.dst: そうだ、Yuman、何のために来た？皆を引っ張ってきたのはお前だろう。
Solidarity of Steel#043.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#044.src: Well, hey, I just thought this old man could use some help, that's all! Six people's a lot for one guy to greet, you know?
Solidarity of Steel#044.dst: いや、じいさん一人じゃ大変だと思っただけさ！六人を一人で出迎えるのは多いだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#044.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#045.src: Yes, yes... Well, alright, since you all are here, we may as well handle introductions now.
Solidarity of Steel#045.dst: そうだな…まあいい、皆そろっているなら、今ここで紹介を済ませよう。
Solidarity of Steel#045.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#046.src: I'm Yuman! I'm the greatest musician of our age, man! And I'm super muscular and cool, and-
Solidarity of Steel#046.dst: 俺は Yuman！当代一の音楽家さ！しかも超マッチョでクールで、それに―
Solidarity of Steel#046.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#047.src: Alright, Yuman, that's enough. I'm Yulie, oldest of three. I work as a detective in {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#047.dst: もういい、Yuman。私は Yulie、三兄弟の長男だ。{p} で探偵をしている。
Solidarity of Steel#047.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#048.src: Booooring! Come on, bro, have some-
Solidarity of Steel#048.dst: つまんなーい！なあ兄貴、もっと―
Solidarity of Steel#048.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#049.src: And I'm Yusanu! I'm a mechanic. Quill's told us a lot about you, it's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Solidarity of Steel#049.dst: 僕は Yusanu！整備士だよ。Quill から君たちの話はよく聞いてる、やっと会えて嬉しい。
Solidarity of Steel#049.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#050.src: Uh... S- same, I guess. This is all s- st- still a bit new.
Solidarity of Steel#050.dst: え…ぼ、僕もかな。まだ全部ちょっと、な、慣れなくて。
Solidarity of Steel#050.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#051.src: Eh, you'll get used to it. This place has a way of growing on you.
Solidarity of Steel#051.dst: まあ、そのうち慣れるさ。ここは不思議と好きになる場所なんだ。
Solidarity of Steel#051.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#052.src: Ah, if I may - I don't suppose you'd have anything prepared for us to be able to blend in better? I'd imagine we stick out a fair bit right now.
Solidarity of Steel#052.dst: あの、よろしいですか？私たちが目立たずに済む物、何かご用意はありませんか？今はかなり浮いているかと。
Solidarity of Steel#052.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#053.src: Hm... I hadn't quite considered that. Boys, why don't you handle that while Syndra and I go ahead to sort out living arrangements?
Solidarity of Steel#053.dst: ふむ…それは考えていなかった。お前たち、頼めるかね？私と Syndra は先に住まいの手配をしてくる。
Solidarity of Steel#053.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#055.src: Leaves, why don't you join them? It'll be a good opportunity to get to know each other.
Solidarity of Steel#055.dst: 葉のみんなも一緒に行ったら？お互いを知るいい機会よ。
Solidarity of Steel#055.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#056.src: Um... I think I'd rather go with you. I'd like to rest a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#056.dst: えっと…私はそっちに行くほうがいいかな。少し休みたいの。
Solidarity of Steel#056.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#057.src: ... Then I'll tag along as well. Perhaps I could be of use at the station!
Solidarity of Steel#057.dst: …では私もご一緒しましょう。駅でお役に立てるかもしれません！
Solidarity of Steel#057.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#058.src: Very well. Follow me, we have an access point this way.
Solidarity of Steel#058.dst: よろしい。ついてきなさい、こっちに入口がある。
Solidarity of Steel#058.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#059.src: Well. I'm afraid I can't stay either... the station doesn't exactly run by itself. We'll have to catch up later!
Solidarity of Steel#059.dst: さて。悪いけど僕も残れないんだ…駅は勝手には動かないからね。また後で話そう！
Solidarity of Steel#059.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#060.src: Ugh, boring as usual... Oh well! Yulie and I can show you around just fine by ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#060.dst: うへぇ、相変わらずつまんねー…ま、いっか！案内なら俺と Yulie で十分さ。
Solidarity of Steel#060.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#061.src: We should start with getting you all some new clothes.
Solidarity of Steel#061.dst: まずは皆の新しい服を用意しよう。
Solidarity of Steel#061.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#062.src: Hey! Wh- what's wrong with our cur- current ones!
Solidarity of Steel#062.dst: ちょっと！い、今の服の何がい、いけないの！
Solidarity of Steel#062.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#063.src: They make you look like poor forest people, man!
Solidarity of Steel#063.dst: 貧乏な森の民に見えるんだよ、なあ！
Solidarity of Steel#063.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#064.src: Yuman! Don't be rude to our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#064.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#065.src: What, I'm just saying! Am I wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#065.dst: 何だよ、言っただけだろ！違うか？
Solidarity of Steel#065.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#066.src: Well! At l- lea- at least we don't smell bad!
Solidarity of Steel#066.dst: ふん！す、少なくとも僕らは臭くないよ！
Solidarity of Steel#066.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#067.src: Alright, boys, settle down, play nice. You're both pretty. So, Yulie, what's the plan?
Solidarity of Steel#067.dst: はいはい、坊やたち、落ち着いて仲良くな。二人とも可愛いよ。で、Yulie、計画は？
Solidarity of Steel#067.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#068.src: I'll have to swing by some shops... Yuman, in the meantime, why don't you see if you can find any clothes around here?
Solidarity of Steel#068.dst: 私はいくつか店を回らないと…Yuman、その間にこの辺りで服を探してくれないか？
Solidarity of Steel#068.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#069.src: Great, I'll join you. I need to get re-acquainted with things around here.
Solidarity of Steel#069.dst: いいね、オレも一緒に行く。この辺りのことを思い出さないとな。
Solidarity of Steel#069.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#070.src: Sure, that works. Any complaints, Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#070.dst: ああ、それでいい。文句は、Yuman？
Solidarity of Steel#070.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#071.src: If I had 'em, you'd hear it loud and clear. The plan's good, bro.
Solidarity of Steel#071.dst: あったらとっくに大声で言ってるって。いい計画だよ、兄貴。
Solidarity of Steel#071.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#072.src: Okay, we'll meet back at the Steel Feather once we're done. See you then!
Solidarity of Steel#072.dst: よし、済んだら鋼の羽根で落ち合おう。ではまた！
Solidarity of Steel#072.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#073.src: ...Well! I've got a plan of my own in mind. Not exactly what Yulie had in mind, but... heh, what he doesn't know won't hurt him. Follow me, leaf people!
Solidarity of Steel#073.dst: …さてと！俺には俺の計画があるんだ。Yulie の考えとはちょっと違うけど…へへ、知らなきゃ困らないさ。ついて来な、葉っぱ連中！
Solidarity of Steel#073.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#074.src: Find clothes in the city by following Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#074.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Yuman について行き、街で服を探す。

Solidarity of Steel#075.src: Hey! Hold- h- hold up! What's your p- p- plan?
Solidarity of Steel#075.dst: ちょっと！ま、待って！き、君の計画って何？
Solidarity of Steel#075.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#076.src: Oh! Right. We're going to steal from the clotheslines, of course.
Solidarity of Steel#076.dst: おっと！そうだった。もちろん物干しから盗むのさ。
Solidarity of Steel#076.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#077.src: ... I'm no stranger to st- stealing, but... isn't it a bit r- r-... a bit risky to do that in the m- middle of the city?
Solidarity of Steel#077.dst: …ぬ、盗みは慣れてるけど…街のま、真ん中でそれはちょっとき、危険じゃない？
Solidarity of Steel#077.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#078.src: Man, haven't you noticed how empty {p} is?
Solidarity of Steel#078.dst: なあ、{p} ががらがらなの気づいてないのか？
Solidarity of Steel#078.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#079.src: Figures you wouldn't know, since you're not from around here! It's pretty simple.
Solidarity of Steel#079.dst: よそ者だから知らないのも無理ないか！簡単な話さ。
Solidarity of Steel#079.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#080.src: It's the middle of the workday! People are out at their jobs, they don't have time to stroll around the city! Got to make a living somehow, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#080.dst: 今は仕事の真っ最中！みんな働きに出てて、街をぶらつく暇なんかないのさ！食ってかなきゃだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#080.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#081.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#081.dst: そ、それで働きに出てるなら、い、家にはいない…つまり他人の部屋をと、通り抜けろってこと？
Solidarity of Steel#081.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#082.src: Yep, yep, exaaaactly! You get it. I think you and I are gonna get along great.
Solidarity of Steel#082.dst: そうそう、その通ーり！わかってるじゃん。お前とは気が合いそうだ。
Solidarity of Steel#082.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#083.src: Yeah... sure. L- let- let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#083.dst: うん…そうだね。い、行こう！この家から屋根にの、登れそうだ。服は上で見つかるよ。
Solidarity of Steel#083.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#084.src: Ha! Really? You should... you should pay more attention, man. The moment you stop keeping an eye on things is the moment things go wrong, y'know? Jeez.
Solidarity of Steel#084.dst: はは！マジで？もっと…もっと周りを見なよ。目を離した瞬間に、物事はおかしくなるもんだぜ？まったく。
Solidarity of Steel#084.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#085.src: What I was gonna say is that it's the middle of the workday. People are out at their jobs! No time to stroll around the city, or anything.
Solidarity of Steel#085.dst: 俺が言おうとしたのは、今は仕事の真っ最中ってこと。みんな働きに出てる！街をぶらつく暇なんかないのさ。
Solidarity of Steel#085.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#086.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#086.dst: そ、それで働きに出てるなら、家にはいない…つまり他人の部屋をと、通り抜けろってこと？
Solidarity of Steel#086.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#087.src: Mhm, yep, you get it. They won't mind! Cause they won' know we were there, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#087.dst: うんうん、わかってるじゃん。気にしないって！俺たちが来たことすら知らないんだからさ。
Solidarity of Steel#087.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#088.src: I- I- I guess. Okay, let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the rooftops from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#088.dst: た、た、たぶんね。よし、行こう！この家から屋根にの、登れそうだ。服は上で見つかるよ。
Solidarity of Steel#088.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#089.src: Climb up the apartment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and jump across the roofs.
Solidarity of Steel#089.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の建物に登り、屋根を跳び移る。

Solidarity of Steel#090.src: Try n-not to fall off the roof...
Solidarity of Steel#090.dst: 屋根から落ちないでね…
Solidarity of Steel#090.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#091.src: Jump across the roofs to the first spot at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Solidarity of Steel#091.dst: 屋根を跳び移り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の最初の地点へ

Solidarity of Steel#092.src: I'll be right be- behind you! Let's get up to the rooftops. I think we can rea- reach them through this building.
Solidarity of Steel#092.dst: す、すぐ後ろにいるよ！屋根に上がろう。この建物から行けそうだ。
Solidarity of Steel#092.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#093.src: ...what the hell are you doin' jumpin' around?
Solidarity of Steel#093.dst: …何をぴょんぴょん跳ね回ってやがる？
Solidarity of Steel#093.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#094.src: Buzz off, some've us got jobs.
Solidarity of Steel#094.dst: 失せな、こっちは仕事中だ。
Solidarity of Steel#094.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#095.src: Here we are! Best clothes in the entire province, man! Take your pick!
Solidarity of Steel#095.dst: 着いたぜ！この地方で一番の服だ！好きなのを選びな！
Solidarity of Steel#095.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#096.src: ... Wait a mi- min- minute. There are only dr- dresses here?
Solidarity of Steel#096.dst: …ちょ、ちょっと待って。ここ、ド、ドレスしかないの？
Solidarity of Steel#096.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#097.src: Oh, yeah. My bad, man! Bet you could pull it off though, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#097.dst: おっと、そうだった。悪い悪い！でもお前なら着こなせるだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#097.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#098.src: I- y- you- wh- wh- what- h- huh? Ev- even- even if I could, Rex and Mora would- w- would never wear- wear these. A- and- and they're n- n- not-
Solidarity of Steel#098.dst: ぼ、き、君、な、な、何、は？た、たとえ僕が着られても、Rex と Mora はぜ、絶対着ないよ。そ、それにふ、二人は―
Solidarity of Steel#098.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#099.src: Relax, I'm just messing with you, man! We'll find some more. But, hey, grab one if you want, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#099.dst: 落ち着けって、からかっただけさ！他のも探そう。でも欲しけりゃ一着持ってけよ？
Solidarity of Steel#099.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#101.src: I'll take one for Sui, just in c- cas- just in case. And let's hurry after him. I'm getting sick a- and-... s- sick and tired of this place already.
Solidarity of Steel#101.dst: ね、念のため Sui に一着持っていくよ。早く彼を追おう。も、もうこの場所にはうんざりだ。
Solidarity of Steel#101.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#102.src: Continue looking for clothes on the rooftops at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#102.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の屋根の上で服探しを続ける。

Solidarity of Steel#103.src: It's g-going to be a long c- couple of days, huh?
Solidarity of Steel#103.dst: な、長い数日になりそうだね。
Solidarity of Steel#103.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#104.src: Careful there, princess! Wouldn't want to fall, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#104.dst: 気をつけな、お姫様！落ちたら大変だろ？
Solidarity of Steel#104.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#105.dst: は？ぼ、僕はそんなんじゃ―
Solidarity of Steel#105.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#106.src: Anyway, these clothes should work, yeah? Looks like enough for all of you!
Solidarity of Steel#106.dst: とにかく、この服ならいけるだろ？全員分ありそうだ！
Solidarity of Steel#106.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#107.src: ...yes, this sh- sh- should be fine. Thank you f- for showing us. Let's just grab them a- and go.
Solidarity of Steel#107.dst: …うん、これでだ、大丈夫そう。案内ありがとう。さっさと取って行こう。
Solidarity of Steel#107.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#108.src: Sounds good! You saw the big statue in the river when you were entering the city, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#108.dst: いいね！街に入る時、川の大きな像を見ただろ？
Solidarity of Steel#108.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#109.src: The one to the s- south- {u}, yes.
Solidarity of Steel#109.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#110.src: That's the one! I'll wait for you there, then we can head to the station. And hurry up, would ya?
Solidarity of Steel#110.dst: それそれ！そこで待ってるから、そしたら駅へ行こう。急いでくれよな？
Solidarity of Steel#110.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#111.src: Find the statue in the water at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#111.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の水中にある像を見つける。

Solidarity of Steel#112.src: Ugh... How can one guy be s- s- so annoying?
Solidarity of Steel#112.dst: はあ…どうしてあんなにう、うっとうしいんだ？
Solidarity of Steel#112.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#113.src: Whatever... Let's just go to that s- st- statue. It's in the river t- to the southwest.
Solidarity of Steel#113.dst: もういいや…あのぞ、像に行こう。南西の川の中だよ。
Solidarity of Steel#113.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#114.src: Ey, there you are! What's with the holdup?
Solidarity of Steel#114.dst: おっ、来たか！何をもたもたしてたんだ？
Solidarity of Steel#114.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#115.src: I was just telling Zeph all about our base of operations! Here, I can start over if you-
Solidarity of Steel#115.dst: 今 Zeph に俺たちのアジトの話をしてたところさ！よし、最初から話してやっても―
Solidarity of Steel#115.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#116.src: Let's just h- head in! Even if the city's empty, the longer we stay out here, the more we ri- risk getting seen.
Solidarity of Steel#116.dst: は、早く入ろう！街に人がいなくても、外に長くいるほど見つかるき、危険が増すよ。
Solidarity of Steel#116.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#117.src: Yeah, yeah, you're right. Okay, follow me! It's just down here.
Solidarity of Steel#117.dst: はいはい、その通り。よし、ついて来な！すぐこの下だ。
Solidarity of Steel#117.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#119.src: Sorry if our secret base isn't up to your high standards, princess! We've got to stay hidden somehow, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#119.dst: 秘密基地がお姫様のお眼鏡にかなわなくて悪いね！隠れるには仕方ないだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#119.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#121.src: Follow Yuman and Zeph into the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#121.dst: Yuman と Zeph について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の下水道に入る。

Solidarity of Steel#123.src: Catch up with Zeph and Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#123.dst: Zeph と Rex に追いつく。

Solidarity of Steel#125.src: Welcome to the station, man! There's a bunch of abandoned train lines down here. Dunno how we first found it, but it's where the Steel Feather operates.
Solidarity of Steel#125.dst: 駅へようこそ！この下には廃線がいっぱいあるんだ。どう見つけたかは知らないけど、鋼の羽根はここで活動してる。
Solidarity of Steel#125.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#127.src: Good to see you've made it down here too. Yuman, you weren't rude to our guests, were you?
Solidarity of Steel#127.dst: 皆も無事に下りてこられたようだな。Yuman、客に失礼はしなかっただろうな？
Solidarity of Steel#127.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#128.src: What? Screw you, man, of course I was nice! When have I ever not been nice and kind and awesome?
Solidarity of Steel#128.dst: は？ふざけんな、もちろん優しくしたさ！俺が優しくて親切で最高じゃなかった時があるか？
Solidarity of Steel#128.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#129.src: Well, either way, I'm sure you've tired them out by now. Let's go on ahead and give them time to catch up, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#129.dst: まあ、どちらにせよもう疲れさせただろう。先に行って、皆が一息つく時間をやろう。
Solidarity of Steel#129.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#130.dst: うへぇ、わかったよー。またな！
Solidarity of Steel#130.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#131.src: So... how've you been finding Yuman so far?
Solidarity of Steel#131.dst: で…Yuman とはここまでどうだった？
Solidarity of Steel#131.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#132.src: Ugh. He's f- fi- fine. We got the clothes, at least.
Solidarity of Steel#132.dst: はあ。べ、別に平気だよ。服は手に入ったし。
Solidarity of Steel#132.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#133.src: Hm. You don't sound fine. Spill.
Solidarity of Steel#133.dst: ふうん。平気そうじゃないな。話せよ。
Solidarity of Steel#133.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#134.src: Oh, that's it? He's just like that.
Solidarity of Steel#134.dst: 何だ、それだけか？あいつはああいう奴さ。
Solidarity of Steel#134.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#135.src: He's just... very p- per- persistent.
Solidarity of Steel#135.dst: ただ…すごくし、しつこくて。
Solidarity of Steel#135.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#136.src: Well, that says more about you than it does about him. Have you tried making it less easy for him?
Solidarity of Steel#136.dst: それはあいつより、お前のことを物語ってるな。からかい甲斐をなくしてみたら？
Solidarity of Steel#136.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#137.src: Ha ha. Very hel- hel- helpful, Rex.
Solidarity of Steel#137.dst: はは。す、すごく参考になるよ、Rex。
Solidarity of Steel#137.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#138.src: Makes sense, I guess. It's been a few days since we've been able to relax, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#138.dst: まあ、そうだろうな。ゆっくりできたのは何日も前だもんな？
Solidarity of Steel#138.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#139.src: Yeah... it'll be n- n- nice to slow down, for a while.
Solidarity of Steel#139.dst: うん…しばらくの、のんびりできたらいいな。
Solidarity of Steel#139.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#140.src: Not sure how long we'll be slowed down... but sure. I think Syndra's got some plans in the works, but she hasn't shared them yet.
Solidarity of Steel#140.dst: どれくらいのんびりできるかはわからないけど…まあな。Syndra には何か計画があるみたいだけど、まだ教えてくれない。
Solidarity of Steel#140.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#141.src: She's been getting... more ambitious lately. {u}, I think having you around has had something to do with that.
Solidarity of Steel#141.dst: 最近あいつ…野心的になってきたんだ。{u}、お前がいることも関係してると思う。
Solidarity of Steel#141.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#142.src: We- we- well, how about you? Is the Roughworks just how you r- remember it?
Solidarity of Steel#142.dst: き、君はどうなの？Roughworks はお、覚えてるとおり？
Solidarity of Steel#142.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#143.src: Yeah... pretty much. Things don't tend to change a lot around here, so... it's just like slotting back into place.
Solidarity of Steel#143.dst: ああ…ほとんどな。ここはあまり変わらないから…元の場所にはまり直すような感じだ。
Solidarity of Steel#143.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#145.src: Ha. No, it really isn't. The few months I spent here before Quill sent me off to Syndra were... rough.
Solidarity of Steel#145.dst: はっ。いや、全然よくない。Quill に Syndra の所へ送られる前の数か月は…きつかった。
Solidarity of Steel#145.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#146.src: Oh... h- how come? You've never really talked about the R- R- Rough-... about the R- Roughworks.
Solidarity of Steel#146.dst: え…ど、どうして？君、R、R、Rough…R、Roughworks の話をしたことないよね。
Solidarity of Steel#146.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#147.src: Uh... Hey, so about those clothes- let's take a look at what you got!
Solidarity of Steel#147.dst: あー…なあ、服の話だけど―何を手に入れたか見せてくれよ！
Solidarity of Steel#147.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#148.src: R- right... right! Well, here are th- the- the, uh, workers' clothes we got f- for me, Mora, and {u}... And this is a dr- dress for Sui...
Solidarity of Steel#148.dst: そ、そうだった！ええと、これは僕と Mora と {u} の、えっと、作業着…それとこれは Sui のド、ドレス…
Solidarity of Steel#148.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#149.src: And, of- of- of course, a simple dress for you!
Solidarity of Steel#149.dst: それと、も、もちろん、君にはシンプルなドレス！
Solidarity of Steel#149.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#150.src: Oh... that's funny, I don't think I've ever worn one of those! Hey, maybe I'll just take your set and you can wear the dress?
Solidarity of Steel#150.dst: へえ…面白いな、ドレスなんて着たことないや！そうだ、オレがお前の服をもらって、お前がドレスを着るってのは？
Solidarity of Steel#150.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#151.src: Woah, ha, we- well, let's not g- g- get too hasty, haha- oh, l- look here, an extra set of re- reg- regular workers' clothes! What a c- co- coincidence!
Solidarity of Steel#151.dst: わっ、は、ちょ、ちょっと、あ、焦らないでよ、はは―あ、み、見て、普通の作業着がもう一着ある！ぐ、偶然だね！
Solidarity of Steel#151.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#152.src: ...don't, uh, m- m- make me wear the dress, please?
Solidarity of Steel#152.dst: …ド、ドレスは着せないで、お願い？
Solidarity of Steel#152.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#153.src: Yeah, yeah. Well, that's enough fooling around - we should find Mora and Sui, see what they've figured out. I'll race you there!
Solidarity of Steel#153.dst: はいはい。さて、おふざけはここまで。Mora と Sui を探して、何かわかったか聞こう。競争だ！
Solidarity of Steel#153.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#154.src: Hey! Oh, you're going d- down!
Solidarity of Steel#154.dst: あっ！ま、負けないからな！
Solidarity of Steel#154.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#155.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Sui と Mora を見つける。

Solidarity of Steel#158.src: Indeed! Tell us, friends, how go the escapades? Has anything of interest transpired up in the city?
Solidarity of Steel#158.dst: まさに！さあ友よ、冒険の首尾はいかがでした？街で何か面白いことは？
Solidarity of Steel#158.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#159.src: No, Mora, nothing very exciting. Yulie and I did a quick supply run in {p} while we were there.
Solidarity of Steel#159.dst: いや、Mora、大したことはなかったよ。Yulie と {p} で物資を少し補充したくらいさ。
Solidarity of Steel#159.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#160.src: And {u} and I found some cl- cl- clothes! They might not fit perfectly, but...
Solidarity of Steel#160.dst: それと {u} と僕でふ、服を見つけたよ！ぴったりじゃないかもだけど…
Solidarity of Steel#160.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#161.src: Ah, well, we'll take what we can get. Besides, I have to imagine they have someone around here who knows their way around modifying clothes!
Solidarity of Steel#161.dst: まあ、あるもので我慢しましょう。それに、ここなら服の仕立て直しに詳しい方もいるはずです！
Solidarity of Steel#161.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#162.src: Speaking of, have you had time to explore this place yet? It's far larger than I could have anticipated! So many people with so many skillsets; Syndra wasn't lying when she said they had resources here, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#162.dst: そういえば、もうここを見て回りました？想像よりずっと広いのです！様々な技能を持つ人がこんなに大勢。資源があるという Syndra の言葉は本当でしたね、ほほ！
Solidarity of Steel#162.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#163.src: Yes... everyone chips in, too. I got put to work quite fast. Had an opportunity to chat with some of the people here.
Solidarity of Steel#163.dst: うん…それにみんなが協力してるの。私もすぐ仕事を任されて。ここの人と少し話せたよ。
Solidarity of Steel#163.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#164.src: They, um... a lot of them don't have anywhere else to go... so they work hard to keep this place running.
Solidarity of Steel#164.dst: えっと…ほかに行く場所がない人が多くて…だからここを保つために一生懸命働いてるの。
Solidarity of Steel#164.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#166.src: Hey, do you know where Yusanu is? I haven't had the chance to catch up with him yet.
Solidarity of Steel#166.dst: なあ、Yusanu がどこにいるか知らないか？まだ話す機会がなくてさ。
Solidarity of Steel#166.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#167.src: Oh, he seemed to have disappeared into his study some time ago, though not before I could have a chat with him! Did you know he singlehandedly repaired much of the abandoned infrastructure here?
Solidarity of Steel#167.dst: ああ、少し前に書斎へ消えてしまいましたよ。その前にお話はできましたが！ここの廃れた設備のほとんどを、彼一人で直したそうですよ？
Solidarity of Steel#167.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#168.dst: 本当？それは…す、すごいね。
Solidarity of Steel#168.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#169.src: Apparently, um, the crown was working on building this, central station, but they... abandoned the project, for, some reason. Nobody... really knows why.
Solidarity of Steel#169.dst: どうやら、えっと、王家がこの中央駅を建てていたけど…なぜか、計画をやめちゃったんだって。理由は…誰も知らないの。
Solidarity of Steel#169.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#170.src: Hm... so what are Syndra and Quill ta- talk- talking about over there?
Solidarity of Steel#170.dst: ふうん…じゃあ Syndra と Quill はあそこで何をは、話してるの？
Solidarity of Steel#170.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#171.src: An excellent question! Nobody knows! Attempting to interject has only resulted in failure thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#171.dst: 良い質問です！誰も知りません！割って入ろうとしましたが、今のところ全敗です。
Solidarity of Steel#171.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#172.src: I mean... should we even interrupt? I haven't seen her this... happy... in a long time.
Solidarity of Steel#172.dst: でも…邪魔していいのかな？あの人がこんなに…嬉しそうなの、久しぶりに見たよ。
Solidarity of Steel#172.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#173.src: It is a sweet moment, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#173.dst: 微笑ましい光景だよな？
Solidarity of Steel#173.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#175.src: Well, I nominate {u} to go interrupt them. It needs to be done eventually.
Solidarity of Steel#175.dst: よし、{u} を邪魔しに行く係に推薦する。いずれ誰かがやらなきゃな。
Solidarity of Steel#175.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#176.src: Oh, yes, I second that notion. If it must be anyone, {u} is the one to sacrifice for the cause.
Solidarity of Steel#176.dst: ええ、賛成です。誰かでなければならないなら、大義の犠牲は {u} こそふさわしい。
Solidarity of Steel#176.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#177.src: Oh! Uh... sure, I'll... th- third it? That sounds right.
Solidarity of Steel#177.dst: あ！えっと…じゃあ、ぼ、僕も三人目の賛成？それでいいよね。
Solidarity of Steel#177.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#179.src: Well! Three for, one against. It seems the decision has been made!
Solidarity of Steel#179.dst: では！賛成三、反対一。決まりのようですね！
Solidarity of Steel#179.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#180.src: Yeah, yeah! Come on, what are you waiting for? Go {u}, and find out what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#180.dst: そうそう！ほら、何を待ってる？行け {u}、何を話してるか探ってこい。
Solidarity of Steel#180.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#181.src: Good luck, my friend! You'll certainly need it.
Solidarity of Steel#181.dst: 幸運を、友よ！きっと必要になりますから。
Solidarity of Steel#181.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#182.src: Your sacrifice will not be in vain.
Solidarity of Steel#182.dst: お前の犠牲は無駄にしない。
Solidarity of Steel#182.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#183.src: I had no p- pa- part in this!
Solidarity of Steel#183.dst: ぼ、僕は関係ないからね！
Solidarity of Steel#183.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#184.src: Don't try to get out of this, Zeph. You're just as complicit in this as the rest of us.
Solidarity of Steel#184.dst: 逃げちゃだめだよ、Zeph。あなたも私たちと同じ共犯なんだから。
Solidarity of Steel#184.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#185.src: Wh- I- fine... {u}, just get it o- over with. Go {u}, and find out what th- they- wh- what they're talking about.
Solidarity of Steel#185.dst: な、ぼ、わかったよ…{u}、さっさとす、済ませてきて。行け {u}、か、彼らが、な、何を話してるか探ってこい。
Solidarity of Steel#185.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#186.src: I will remember you fondly, my friend.
Solidarity of Steel#186.dst: あなたのことは懐かしく偲びますよ。
Solidarity of Steel#186.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#187.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Syndra を見つける。

Solidarity of Steel#190.src: H-hey! Don't you have a m-mission to do?
Solidarity of Steel#190.dst: ちょ、ちょっと！に、任務があるんじゃないの？
Solidarity of Steel#190.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#191.src: Ah, {u}! I see you have all returned. Welcome to our home.
Solidarity of Steel#191.dst: おお、{u}！皆戻ったようだね。我らが家へようこそ。
Solidarity of Steel#191.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#192.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but he tends towards
Solidarity of Steel#192.dst: 兄弟たちが迷惑をかけていなければいいが。特に Yuman は…いい子なんだが、どうも
Solidarity of Steel#192.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#193.src: Speaking of nuisances... I can't help but notice the rest of our group looking onwards at our conversation with excitement.
Solidarity of Steel#193.dst: 迷惑といえば…ほかのみんなが、私たちの会話を興味津々で見ているのが気になるわね。
Solidarity of Steel#193.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#194.src: Ah! Understood. A noble one, at that.
Solidarity of Steel#194.dst: あら！わかったわ。立派な任務ね。
Solidarity of Steel#194.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#195.src: In any case, Quill and I have been trying to plan out our next moves... but, if I'm being honest, most of that time has been spent catching up.
Solidarity of Steel#195.dst: とにかく、Quill と次の手を考えていたんだけど…正直、ほとんど積もる話で終わっちゃったわ。
Solidarity of Steel#195.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#196.src: Don't be fooled. All of these people here are resisting to some extent, but very few are ready to go up against a God.
Solidarity of Steel#196.dst: だまされるな。ここの者は皆、何かしら抵抗しているが、神に立ち向かう覚悟のある者はごく僅かだ。
Solidarity of Steel#196.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#197.src: Hah! Goodness, how long has it been since we met face to face? It must have been... {~} years? Not since before you-
Solidarity of Steel#197.dst: はは！いやはや、直に会うのは何年ぶりだ？…{~} 年か？君が、あの―
Solidarity of Steel#197.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#199.src: ...Ahem. Yes, of course. As Syndra said, we haven't truly started planning yet... You must be surprised by our numbers, yes? More members in the Steel Feather than you'd have expected.
Solidarity of Steel#199.dst: …ゴホン。ああ、もちろん。Syndra の言うとおり、計画はまだ本格的には始めていない…我々の人数に驚いただろう？鋼の羽根の仲間は思ったより多いはずだ。
Solidarity of Steel#199.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#200.src: In truth, looks may be deceiving. Everyone here is resisting in whatever ways they can manage, but few are willing to put as much of themselves into it as your group.
Solidarity of Steel#200.dst: だが実のところ、見かけに惑わされてはいかん。皆それぞれできる形で抵抗しているが、君たちほど身を投じる者はほとんどいない。
Solidarity of Steel#200.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#201.src: Most of them are simply trying to live without the watchful eye of the monarchy. Our safe haven takes in people who are at risk. People who can't work, who have been thrown out of their homes...
Solidarity of Steel#201.dst: 大半は王家の監視の目を逃れて暮らしたいだけなのだ。この隠れ家は危うい立場の人々を受け入れている。働けない人、家を追われた人…
Solidarity of Steel#201.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#202.src: But we are not helpless. The brothers and I are all ready to help, however we can. And the rest of the Steel Feather will still offer support from the sidelines. We have infrastructure, and we have resources.
Solidarity of Steel#202.dst: だが我々は無力ではない。私も兄弟たちも、できる限り力を貸すつもりだ。鋼の羽根の他の者も陰から支えてくれる。設備もあるし、資源もある。
Solidarity of Steel#202.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#203.src: I've also suggested that you might offer to teach the basics of magic to those who are interested-
Solidarity of Steel#203.dst: 興味のある人に、魔法の基礎を教えてはどうかとも提案したんだけど―
Solidarity of Steel#203.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#204.src: Yes, yes, but I do not believe we need curses or blessings to resist. As I've told you several times before in our correspondences, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#204.dst: ああ、ああ、だが抵抗に呪いも祝福も必要ないと思う。手紙で何度もそう言っただろう、Syndra！
Solidarity of Steel#204.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#205.src: And as I've told you in response, I see no reason not to make use of all the tools available!
Solidarity of Steel#205.dst: そして私も返事で言ったわ、使える道具を全部使わない理由はないって！
Solidarity of Steel#205.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#206.src: Syndra, I have been firm on this point for a reason. We have done well for ourselves thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#206.dst: Syndra、この点を譲らないのには理由がある。我々はこれまで自力でうまくやってきた。
Solidarity of Steel#206.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#207.src: As an example- Yusanu has grown quite proficient with machinery. He has constructed weaponry, tools- even my leg is his creation!
Solidarity of Steel#207.dst: 例えば―Yusanu は機械の扱いがすっかり上達した。武器や道具を作り―私の脚さえ彼の作品だ！
Solidarity of Steel#207.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#208.src: ... I simply think that-... Sigh. Fine. Quill, we should get to discussing the reason we came here.
Solidarity of Steel#208.dst: …私はただ…はあ。わかったわ。Quill、ここに来た本題に入りましょう。
Solidarity of Steel#208.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#209.src: Yes, I rather think we should. {u}, in the meantime, why don't you take a look around the station? Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#209.dst: ああ、そうすべきだな。{u}、その間に駅を見て回ってはどうかね？この場所と人々に慣れておくといい。
Solidarity of Steel#209.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#210.src: Explore the Steel Feather train station at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#210.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の鋼の羽根の駅を探索する。

Solidarity of Steel#211.src: Take a look around the station! Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#211.dst: 駅を見て回っておいで！この場所と人々に慣れておくといい。
Solidarity of Steel#211.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#212.src: Hoho! So they return! Tell us, how did it go?
Solidarity of Steel#212.dst: ほほ！戻ってきましたね！どうでした？
Solidarity of Steel#212.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#213.dst: ああ、なんてこった…悲劇だな。
Solidarity of Steel#213.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#214.src: Ah, we all knew the stakes going in! Worry not, friend, your sacrifice will not be forgotten any time soon!
Solidarity of Steel#214.dst: まあ、危険は承知の上でしたから！ご安心を、友よ、あなたの犠牲はそうそう忘れられません！
Solidarity of Steel#214.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#215.src: Hey! E- e- enough with the theatrics!
Solidarity of Steel#215.dst: ちょっと！し、芝居はもういいよ！
Solidarity of Steel#215.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#216.src: Excellent! You have successfully defied the odds, friend!
Solidarity of Steel#216.dst: 素晴らしい！見事に不利を覆しましたね、友よ！
Solidarity of Steel#216.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#217.src: Zeph didn't believe you'd make it, you know.
Solidarity of Steel#217.dst: Zeph はあなたが無事に戻るなんて思ってなかったんだよ。
Solidarity of Steel#217.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#218.src: Wh- what, n- no I- I didn't- Sui!! D- don't- don't believe a word- a word she says, o- okay?
Solidarity of Steel#218.dst: な、な、違う、ぼ、僕はそんな―Sui！！こ、この子の言うことは、ひ、一言も信じないで、い、いい？
Solidarity of Steel#218.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#219.src: Wh- what were they talking about, anyway?
Solidarity of Steel#219.dst: そ、それで結局、何を話してたの？
Solidarity of Steel#219.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#220.src: Oh, so it was as boring as I predicted.
Solidarity of Steel#220.dst: なんだ、予想どおり退屈な話か。
Solidarity of Steel#220.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#221.src: Don't call that boring, Rex! It's... nice for her to relax for a little, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#221.dst: 退屈なんて言わないで、Rex！あの人が少し息抜きできるのは…いいことでしょ？
Solidarity of Steel#221.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#222.src: It can be both boring and a nice thing, can it not? The nice things often tend towards the boring end of the spectrum, in any case.
Solidarity of Steel#222.dst: 退屈で、かつ良いこともあり得るでしょう？どのみち、良いことほど退屈な側に寄りがちなものです。
Solidarity of Steel#222.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#223.src: So, still n- nothing about the plans... when is she go- go- going to tell us anything?
Solidarity of Steel#223.dst: じゃあ、計画のことはま、まだ何も…いつになったらお、教えてくれるんだろう？
Solidarity of Steel#223.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#224.src: Have patience, young Leaf. She will tell us when it is time! Now, Sui and I have had the opportunity to explore, but you three have not! So, go on! Look around, talk to people.
Solidarity of Steel#224.dst: 焦りは禁物ですよ、若葉くん。時が来れば話してくれます！さて、Sui と私はもう見て回りましたが、あなたたち三人はまだ！さあ、行って！見て回り、人と話すのです。
Solidarity of Steel#224.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#225.dst: 見て回ってらっしゃい！
Solidarity of Steel#225.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#226.src: Ah. You're all back already? Man, I totally lost track of time there... there's so much to do.
Solidarity of Steel#226.dst: あ。もう皆戻ってきたの？うわ、完全に時間を忘れてた…やることが多すぎて。
Solidarity of Steel#226.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#227.src: So, what's up? Sorry I couldn't talk to you more earlier- I'm the one who makes sure everything runs smoothly here.
Solidarity of Steel#227.dst: で、どうしたの？さっきはあまり話せなくてごめん―ここが円滑に回るよう見てるのは僕なんだ。
Solidarity of Steel#227.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#228.src: Most of the infrastructure was here already, but I basically fixed it all up myself... with some help, of course. But now I'm in charge of maintaining all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#228.dst: 設備のほとんどは元からあったけど、基本的に全部僕が直したんだ…もちろん手伝いはあったけどね。今はその保守を全部任されてる！
Solidarity of Steel#228.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#229.src: It's not usually this... hectic. We had some stuff break down recently, and I'm the oooonly one who can deal with it!
Solidarity of Steel#229.dst: 普段はこんなに…慌ただしくないんだ。最近いくつか壊れて、直せるのは僕だけなんだよー！
Solidarity of Steel#229.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#231.src: ... Still don't have time to chat, sorry! I'm nearly done, though, I'll be out in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#231.dst: …やっぱり話す暇がないや、ごめん！でももうすぐ終わるから、少ししたら出るよ。
Solidarity of Steel#231.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#232.dst: よう！お友達はどこ行った？
Solidarity of Steel#232.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#233.dst: もう恋しくなってきたぜ。
Solidarity of Steel#233.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#234.src: Hah! Yeah, yeah, maybe. I was hoping to tease him some more.
Solidarity of Steel#234.dst: はは！まあまあ、かもな。もっとあいつをからかいたかったんだけど。
Solidarity of Steel#234.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#235.src: He's a fun guy! But the boy's gotta learn how to tease back... it's no fun if it's one-side, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#235.dst: 面白い奴だよ！でもからかい返すことも覚えなきゃな…一方的じゃつまんないだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#235.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#236.src: ...what? Ey, don't look at me like that! It's all for fun at the end of the day. If he tells me to quit it, I'll quit it.
Solidarity of Steel#236.dst: …何だよ？おい、そんな目で見るなって！結局はただの遊びさ。やめろって言われたらやめるよ。
Solidarity of Steel#236.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#238.src: I'll... go over there later. Eventually! ... Maybe.
Solidarity of Steel#238.dst: 俺は…後でそっちに行くよ。そのうち！…たぶん。
Solidarity of Steel#238.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#239.src: Eheh. Wouldn't want to overstay my welcome, y'know? I've got things to do, anyway...
Solidarity of Steel#239.dst: えへへ。長居して嫌われたくないだろ？どうせやることもあるしな…
Solidarity of Steel#239.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#240.src: ...so, you exploring? That's good! I'd show you around, but... eheh, I'm uh, working on a little something right now.
Solidarity of Steel#240.dst: …で、探検中か？いいね！案内したいけど…えへへ、今ちょっと作ってるものがあってさ。
Solidarity of Steel#240.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#241.src: Yo, quit trying to sneak a peak at it! No spoilers! You'll see it tonight, if I get it done.
Solidarity of Steel#241.dst: おい、こっそり覗くなって！ネタバレ禁止！完成したら今夜見せてやるよ。
Solidarity of Steel#241.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#242.dst: おい！覗くなって言ったろ！
Solidarity of Steel#242.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#243.src: Hm. I suppose you're used to invading personal space?
Solidarity of Steel#243.dst: ふむ。人の領域に踏み込むのは慣れているようだな？
Solidarity of Steel#243.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#244.src: Don't worry, I'm not upset. I appreciate the effort in familiarizing yourself with this place.
Solidarity of Steel#244.dst: 心配するな、怒ってはいない。この場所に馴染もうとする姿勢はありがたい。
Solidarity of Steel#244.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#245.src: Did you have a question, or are you just looking around?
Solidarity of Steel#245.dst: 何か聞きたいことが？それとも見て回っているだけか？
Solidarity of Steel#245.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#246.src: Oh, has he done something again? Of course he has... I apologize for my brother's actions.
Solidarity of Steel#246.dst: ああ、また何かやらかしたか？そうに決まっている…弟の振る舞いを詫びよう。
Solidarity of Steel#246.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#247.src: He's... hard to keep a handle on. Energetic, impulsive... I do love him, but do I ever wish he would cause less trouble.
Solidarity of Steel#247.dst: あいつは…手に負えなくてな。元気で、衝動的で…愛してはいるが、もう少し面倒を減らしてほしいものだ。
Solidarity of Steel#247.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#249.src: Ah. Then I apologize for my assumption.
Solidarity of Steel#249.dst: そうか。早合点して悪かった。
Solidarity of Steel#249.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#250.src: He's... I might be too hard on him sometimes. He does help out a lot around here, he does- just... like I said. Energetic and impulsive.
Solidarity of Steel#250.dst: あいつは…私が厳しすぎる時もあるかもしれん。ここでよく手伝ってくれるのは確かだ―ただ…言ったとおり、元気で衝動的でな。
Solidarity of Steel#250.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#251.src: You'll get used to his personality, with time. Everyone does.
Solidarity of Steel#251.dst: 時間が経てばあいつの性格にも慣れる。皆そうだ。
Solidarity of Steel#251.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#252.src: But in any case, I'll speak with him about it. He should know better than to bother our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#252.dst: いずれにせよ、あいつには私から話しておく。客を煩わせるべきではないとわかっているはずだ。
Solidarity of Steel#252.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#253.src: I have to get back to work. I'll see you around.
Solidarity of Steel#253.dst: 仕事に戻らないと。ではまた。
Solidarity of Steel#253.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#254.src: Hm? My role? That's a bit of a complex question, actually. In the Steel Feather... I don't do much.
Solidarity of Steel#254.dst: ん？私の役割？実は少々複雑な質問だ。鋼の羽根では…大したことはしていない。
Solidarity of Steel#254.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#255.src: But I work as a consulting detective for the crown, in the city. I perform investigations for them, but I also gather information for us - keeping tabs on the military, and such.
Solidarity of Steel#255.dst: だが街では王家の顧問探偵として働いている。彼らのために捜査をしつつ、我々のために情報も集めている―軍の動向などをな。
Solidarity of Steel#255.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#256.src: Besides, the pay's... decent enough. A few emeralds in my pocket helps all of us down here. Unfortunately, we can't produce everything ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#256.dst: それに給料も…まあ悪くない。私の懐のエメラルドが、下の皆の助けになる。残念ながら、何もかも自給はできないのでな。
Solidarity of Steel#256.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#257.src: But speaking of my work, I... am actually busy preparing for a meeting right now. {p}'s Commander wants us on the lookout for... something, he hasn't told us yet.
Solidarity of Steel#257.dst: 仕事といえば…実は今、会議の準備で忙しい。{p} の司令官が何かを警戒しろと言っているが…まだ何かは明かされていない。
Solidarity of Steel#257.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#258.src: But it's my duty to find out, so into the city I will go. If you'll excuse me, I'll get back to preparing now.
Solidarity of Steel#258.dst: だが突き止めるのが私の務めだ、街へ行ってくる。失礼、準備に戻らせてもらう。
Solidarity of Steel#258.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#259.src: Return to the main room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#260.dst: …あの子は元気？変わりはない？
Solidarity of Steel#260.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#261.src: Nothing beyond what I'd written in our letters.
Solidarity of Steel#261.dst: 手紙に書いた以上のことはないよ。
Solidarity of Steel#261.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#262.src: Alright... thank you, Quill. Just a little longer, then I-
Solidarity of Steel#262.dst: そう…ありがとう、Quill。あと少しだけ、そうしたら私―
Solidarity of Steel#262.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#263.src: Ah, {u}! What do you think of our home? It took a great deal of planning to get the station up and running, but I feel we've done a good-
Solidarity of Steel#263.dst: おお、{u}！我らが家はどうだね？この駅を動かすにはずいぶん計画が要ったが、なかなか上手く―
Solidarity of Steel#263.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#266.src: I overheard... an altercation... between a woma-... and a- ...dier...
Solidarity of Steel#266.dst: 聞こえたんです…言い争いが…女の…と…兵…
Solidarity of Steel#266.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#267.src: Calm yourself, Jiro. Take a breath, and repeat
Solidarity of Steel#267.dst: 落ち着け、Jiro。深呼吸して、もう一度
Solidarity of Steel#267.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#268.src: A woman is being kicked out... again! I don't know the details, but I think she didn't reach her quota for the month.
Solidarity of Steel#268.dst: 女性がまた追い出されそうなんです！詳しくはわかりませんが、今月のノルマに届かなかったようで。
Solidarity of Steel#268.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#270.src: Living Block {~} - through the southwestern tunnel.
Solidarity of Steel#270.dst: 第 {~} 居住区です―南西のトンネルの先。
Solidarity of Steel#270.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#274.src: We're heading out. Rescue mission. Yuman, where's Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#274.dst: 出るぞ。救出任務だ。Yuman、Yulie はどこだ？
Solidarity of Steel#274.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#275.src: He has a meeting in the city today, remember? He told all of us this morning.
Solidarity of Steel#275.dst: 今日は街で会議だろ、忘れたのか？今朝みんなに言ってたじゃん。
Solidarity of Steel#275.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#276.src: ...Right. Right, he did say- alright. We'll have to go in blind, then. Not ideal, but it can't be helped-
Solidarity of Steel#276.dst: …そうだ。そうだった―よし。なら情報なしで行くしかない。理想的じゃないけど、仕方ない―
Solidarity of Steel#276.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#277.src: Damn it! Not now, of all times to-
Solidarity of Steel#277.dst: くそっ！よりによって今―
Solidarity of Steel#277.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#278.src: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#278.dst: どうしたの？何かあった？
Solidarity of Steel#278.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#279.src: No, no, nothing's- it's nothing bad... I hope. I just need to... check what triggered the alarm. Ugh, can anything go right today...
Solidarity of Steel#279.dst: いや、いや、何も―悪いことじゃない…と思う。何が警報を鳴らしたか確かめないと。はあ、今日は何ひとつ上手くいかないな…
Solidarity of Steel#279.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#280.src: Hey, bro, don't worry about it. I'll handle it! You take care of whatever you need to, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#280.dst: おい兄貴、心配すんなって。俺が片付ける！兄貴はやるべきことをやってくれ、な？
Solidarity of Steel#280.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#281.src: ...Okay. Okay, thanks, Yuman. I owe you one.
Solidarity of Steel#281.dst: …わかった。わかった、ありがとう、Yuman。借りができたね。
Solidarity of Steel#281.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#282.src: Hey, one of these days I'll collect on all those ones you owe me! Don't think you can dodge that just cause you're my bro!
Solidarity of Steel#282.dst: へっ、いつかその借り、全部まとめて返してもらうからな！兄弟だからって逃げられると思うなよ！
Solidarity of Steel#282.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#283.src: Will you n- ne- need help? {u} and I can join if y- if you need us.
Solidarity of Steel#283.dst: て、手伝いはい、要る？必要なら僕と {u} も行くよ。
Solidarity of Steel#283.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#284.src: Was just about to ask the same thing! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, you all listen to my orders 'till this is sorted! Got it?
Solidarity of Steel#284.dst: ちょうど同じことを聞こうと思ってた！Jiro、Zeph、{u}、片付くまで全員俺の命令に従え！いいな？
Solidarity of Steel#284.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#286.src: You forgot the "sir" at the end, there! Anyway, let me grab my guitar, and let's head out!
Solidarity of Steel#286.dst: 最後に「サー」をつけ忘れてるぞ！ともかく、ギターを取ってくるから、出発だ！
Solidarity of Steel#286.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#288.src: Don't ask, you'll find out later. We need to get moving now.
Solidarity of Steel#288.dst: 聞くな、後でわかる。今はすぐ動かないと。
Solidarity of Steel#288.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#290.src: Follow Yuman to the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#290.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のトンネルまで Yuman について行く。

Solidarity of Steel#291.dst: みんな無事だといいけど。
Solidarity of Steel#291.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#292.src: I hope Yuman doesn't annoy them to death...
Solidarity of Steel#292.dst: Yuman が皆を死ぬほどうんざりさせんといいが…
Solidarity of Steel#292.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#293.src: Th- through here! Yuman and Jiro are s- sc- scouting up ahead.
Solidarity of Steel#293.dst: こ、こっちだよ！Yuman と Jiro がて、偵察に先行してる。
Solidarity of Steel#293.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#294.src: Find the woman in trouble at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#294.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で困っている女性を見つける。

Solidarity of Steel#295.src: I see them up a- a- ahead... Let's join up with them. Fo- follow me!
Solidarity of Steel#295.dst: さ、先に二人が見える…合流しよう。つ、ついて来て！
Solidarity of Steel#295.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#297.src: Alright, lady! Time's up! It's time to get going.
Solidarity of Steel#297.dst: よし、ご婦人！時間切れだ！さあ出て行ってもらおう。
Solidarity of Steel#297.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#298.src: We need to clean up this filthy apartment of yours for whoever's next in line. We've got a tight schedule, so don't make this harder than it needs to be, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#298.dst: この汚い部屋を、次に並んでる奴のために片付けなきゃならん。予定が詰まってるんだ、余計な手間をかけさせるなよ？
Solidarity of Steel#298.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#299.src: W-w-wait! I still need to pack! You haven't given me enough time!
Solidarity of Steel#299.dst: ま、ま、待って！まだ荷造りが！時間が足りません！
Solidarity of Steel#299.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#300.src: You received an eviction notice last night, detailing the protocol, didn't you? You've had plenty of time already, lady.
Solidarity of Steel#300.dst: 昨夜、手順を書いた退去通知を受け取っただろう？時間はもう十分あったはずだ、ご婦人。
Solidarity of Steel#300.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#301.src: Unless what you mean to say is you take issue with the system? We've got a formal complaints department, lady, but I don't think you'd enjoy paying them a visit.
Solidarity of Steel#301.dst: それとも、制度に文句があると言いたいのか？正式な苦情処理部門もあるが、ご婦人、あそこを訪ねるのは楽しくないと思うぞ。
Solidarity of Steel#301.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#302.src: N-n-no! No, it- it's fine! I-I-I just- I'm just saying th-that- I just need a couple of minutes... Please!
Solidarity of Steel#302.dst: い、い、いえ！いえ、だ、大丈夫です！わ、わ、私はただ―ただ、数分だけ欲しくて…お願いします！
Solidarity of Steel#302.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#303.src: Sigh. I did warn you, lady. Guess we're doing things the hard way, then.
Solidarity of Steel#303.dst: はあ。警告はしたぞ、ご婦人。なら手荒にやるしかないな。
Solidarity of Steel#303.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#304.dst: い、いや…ご、ごめんなさい！
Solidarity of Steel#304.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#305.src: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm-
Solidarity of Steel#305.dst: ごめんなさい！ごめんなさい、ごめ―
Solidarity of Steel#305.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#306.src: Disrespecting the crown is a serious crime, y'know. Alright, boys, you know what to do.
Solidarity of Steel#306.dst: 王家への不敬は重罪だぞ。よし、お前ら、やることはわかってるな。
Solidarity of Steel#306.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#307.src: Hey! We n- ne- need to hel- help her!
Solidarity of Steel#307.dst: ちょっと！た、助けなきゃ！
Solidarity of Steel#307.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#308.src: Quiet! It's not protocol, we need to wait until the coast's clear, or else-
Solidarity of Steel#308.dst: 静かに！手順と違う、周りに誰もいなくなるまで待たないと、でないと―
Solidarity of Steel#308.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#309.src: But th- they're going to beat her! We c- can- we c- can't just let that-
Solidarity of Steel#309.dst: で、でも彼女が殴られるよ！こ、このまま見て、見てるなんて―
Solidarity of Steel#309.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#310.src: You're new here, so you get a pass for not knowing, but we cannot draw attention towards us.
Solidarity of Steel#310.dst: 新入りだから知らないのは仕方ないが、俺たちは注目を集めるわけにはいかないんだ。
Solidarity of Steel#310.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#311.src: Yeah, man! If the guards get a whiff of what we're doing, we're toast! The only reason we have the station is 'cause they don't know about it!
Solidarity of Steel#311.dst: そうだぜ！衛兵に俺たちのことを嗅ぎつけられたら、おしまいだ！駅を守れてるのは、あいつらが知らないからなんだ！
Solidarity of Steel#311.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#313.src: M- m- maybe hiding is enough f- f- for you, but I c- ca- can't just let someone get h- hur- hurt!
Solidarity of Steel#313.dst: か、隠れるだけで君たちはいいかもしれないけど、ぼ、僕は誰かがき、傷つくのを放っておけない！
Solidarity of Steel#313.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#314.src: S- so-... so sc- screw your cover! She n- n- needs help, so I- I'm going to h- he- help!
Solidarity of Steel#314.dst: だ、だから…隠れ蓑なんか知るか！彼女は助けがひ、必要なんだ、だから僕はた、助ける！
Solidarity of Steel#314.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#315.src: Hey, don't!-... Damn it. Man, how am I gonna explain this to...
Solidarity of Steel#315.dst: おい、待て！―くそっ。まったく、これをどう説明すりゃ…
Solidarity of Steel#315.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#316.src: Defeat the soldiers attacking the woman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#316.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で女性を襲う兵士を倒す。

Solidarity of Steel#317.src: Fine, man! Can't just let you fight alone, can we? Let's just get this over with...
Solidarity of Steel#317.dst: わかったよ！一人で戦わせるわけにはいかないもんな？さっさと終わらせようぜ…
Solidarity of Steel#317.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#319.src: ..Okay. I th- th- I think the coast is clear. She sh- sh- should be-
Solidarity of Steel#319.dst: …よし。も、もう周りに誰もいないと思う。彼女はた、たぶん―
Solidarity of Steel#319.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#320.src: What the hell was that? What were you thinking?!
Solidarity of Steel#320.dst: 今のは一体何だ？何を考えてたんだ！？
Solidarity of Steel#320.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#322.src: No, I really think I should-
Solidarity of Steel#322.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#323.src: Jiro. We've got other things to worry about, man. Cool it till we're back at the station, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#323.dst: Jiro。他に心配することがあるだろ。駅に戻るまで頭を冷やせ、な？
Solidarity of Steel#323.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#326.src: Wh-who are you people? What are- what are you doing here?
Solidarity of Steel#326.dst: あ、あなたたちは誰？ここで、ここで何をしてるの？
Solidarity of Steel#326.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#327.src: One can learn so much of the community's spirit by surveying the boards. See what they're worried of, see the way they support each other, see their culture...
Solidarity of Steel#327.dst: 掲示板を眺めるだけで、共同体の精神が多くわかる。何を憂い、どう支え合い、どんな文化なのか…

Solidarity of Steel#328.src: Donated {~} IA by Sovereign Zhiraok after vandalization of previous noticeboard.
Solidarity of Steel#328.dst: 前の掲示板が壊された後、君主 Zhiraok より {~} IA 寄贈。

Solidarity of Steel#329.src: Said it was the Sovereign's problem, but I know the real reason. He just didn't want to go into The Flush.
Solidarity of Steel#329.dst: 君主の問題だとあいつは言ったが、本当の理由は知ってる。放水路に入りたくなかっただけさ。

Solidarity of Steel#330.src: You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
Solidarity of Steel#330.dst: 俺たちのことは知らないし、俺たちも君を知らない。でも助けに来たんだ。俺は Yuman、こっちは―
Solidarity of Steel#330.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#331.src: Why... why would you... help me...?
Solidarity of Steel#331.dst: どうして…どうして私を…助けて…？
Solidarity of Steel#331.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#332.src: 'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
Solidarity of Steel#332.dst: それが…俺たちみたいな人間のやるべきことだからさ。
Solidarity of Steel#332.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#333.src: No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
Solidarity of Steel#333.dst: 違う！ち、ち、違う…私たちみたいな人間は言われたとおりにして、関係ないことに関わっちゃいけないの！
Solidarity of Steel#333.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#335.src: If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
Solidarity of Steel#335.dst: 命令に従っていれば、少なくとも生きていける！部屋を失うかもしれない、自分で築いたもの全部も、なんとか守ってきた物も全部、でも―でも―でも少なくとも生きていられる！
Solidarity of Steel#335.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#336.src: ...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Solidarity of Steel#336.dst: …わかるよ。信じてくれ、Aihan、本当にわかるんだ。
Solidarity of Steel#336.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#337.src: Can I tell you a story?
Solidarity of Steel#337.dst: ひとつ話をしてもいいか？
Solidarity of Steel#337.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#339.src: Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
Solidarity of Steel#339.dst: 昔々、俺がまだちっちゃかった頃、母ちゃんを亡くした。親父はいなくて…だから兄貴たちが俺の面倒を見なきゃならなかった、自分たちもまだ子供だったのに。
Solidarity of Steel#339.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#340.src: But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
Solidarity of Steel#340.dst: でもさ、子供は子供…十分には稼げなかった。ノルマに届かなかったんだ、君と同じように。追い出されて、路上暮らしさ。
Solidarity of Steel#340.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#341.src: You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
Solidarity of Steel#341.dst: どうやって乗り越えたか知りたいか？誰かが手を差し伸べてくれたからさ。住む場所をくれた、期待に応えられない恐怖なしで働ける場所を。生きる場所をな。
Solidarity of Steel#341.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#342.src: So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
Solidarity of Steel#342.dst: だから…頼む。差し出された手を取ってくれ、な？一緒に来てボスと話してみな。それで足りなけりゃ…誰も無理に引き止めない。でも、試してみてくれないか？
Solidarity of Steel#342.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#344.src: Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
Solidarity of Steel#344.dst: 水を差すようで悪いが、Yuman、兵士がもっとこっちに来てる！すぐ移動しないと！
Solidarity of Steel#344.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#345.src: Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
Solidarity of Steel#345.dst: くそ…わかった。Aihan、俺を信じてくれるか？
Solidarity of Steel#345.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#346.dst: わ…わかった。や…やってみる。
Solidarity of Steel#346.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#347.src: Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
Solidarity of Steel#347.dst: よし…よし。ありがとう。{u}、荷造りを手伝ってやってくれ。Zeph、Jiro、逃げ道の準備を手伝え。
Solidarity of Steel#347.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#348.src: W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
Solidarity of Steel#348.dst: ま、待って！な…何を詰めればいいのかわからない！
Solidarity of Steel#348.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#349.src: Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
Solidarity of Steel#349.dst: そうだな。えーと…重い物は持ってくな。行き先には食料も調理器具もあるから…
Solidarity of Steel#349.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#350.src: Bring something to with, something that ... and maybe some form of {u}, if you've got any.
Solidarity of Steel#350.dst: 持ってくのは、…ための物と、…する物…あと、あれば何か {u} もな。
Solidarity of Steel#350.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#352.src: I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
Solidarity of Steel#352.dst: わ…私、頭が回らない…何もかも速すぎて…お願い―お願い、手伝ってくれる？
Solidarity of Steel#352.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#353.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Aihan の荷造りを手伝う。

Solidarity of Steel#354.src: Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#354.dst: それを取って…いいと思う物を選んで…
Solidarity of Steel#354.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#355.src: We have to hurry but I just can't think!
Solidarity of Steel#355.dst: 急がなきゃなのに、頭が真っ白！
Solidarity of Steel#355.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#356.src: Pack something to help Aihan some form of a piece of and something to
Solidarity of Steel#356.dst: Aihan のために必要な物を詰める

Solidarity of Steel#357.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#357.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#359.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#359.dst: ど、どこへ行くの？こ、ここに置いていかないで！
Solidarity of Steel#359.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#360.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#360.dst: 全部持った？もう行ける？
Solidarity of Steel#360.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#361.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#361.dst: よし…まだ誰も来てない。行こう！
Solidarity of Steel#361.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#363.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#363.dst: 時間切れだ、移動するぞ！急げ、急げ！
Solidarity of Steel#363.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#364.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#364.dst: 梯子を登って、トンネルへ！行け、行け、行け！
Solidarity of Steel#364.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#368.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#368.dst: なあ…お前がやったのは本当にバカなことだぞ。天文学的なバカさ、わかるか？
Solidarity of Steel#368.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#370.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#370.dst: でも、わかるよ。わかるんだ。あそこでリーダーじゃなかったら、俺もたぶん同じことしてた！
Solidarity of Steel#370.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#371.dst: 違うのは、俺には兄貴たちが止めてくれるってこと。俺はここでそれができなかったな…
Solidarity of Steel#371.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#372.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#372.dst: 兄貴たちをがっかりさせたくないんだよ。でももう遅いか。やっちまったもんは取り消せない。
Solidarity of Steel#372.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#373.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#373.dst: 大丈夫さ。もっとひどいこともあった。Aihan は無事、それが一番大事だ！残りはその都度どうにかするさ。
Solidarity of Steel#373.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#374.dst: ぼ、僕…君の言うことをき、聞くべきだった。でも、あ、あいつらが彼女をあんなふうに扱うのを見て…た、ただすごく…腹が立って。人をあんなふうに見下すなんて、ゆ、許せない！
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#375.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#375.dst: ああ…わかるよ。痛いほどわかる。間違ってるよな？でも、それを正すために俺たちはここで頑張ってるんだ。できることをやるしかないだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#375.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#376.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#376.dst: 行こうぜ。みんな待ってる。待たせたくないしな。
Solidarity of Steel#376.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#378.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のトンネルを通って鋼の羽根に戻る。

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Solidarity of Steel#379.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の鋼の羽根に起きたことを報告する。

Solidarity of Steel#381.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#381.dst: へ、変かな…あいつにし、真剣な一面があるとわかって、ほっとしたって言ったら？
Solidarity of Steel#381.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#382.dst: こ、こんな形で知りたくはな、なかったけど…
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#384.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#384.dst: 俺と Jiro で落ち着かせたよ。今 Quill が事情を説明してる。
Solidarity of Steel#384.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#385.dst: Jiro はしばらく避けといたほうがいいぜ？あいつ…ご機嫌斜めだ。
Solidarity of Steel#385.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#386.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#386.dst: わ…わかった。そ、それで…これからどうするの？任務をどこかにき、記録するの？
Solidarity of Steel#386.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: そうそう！普段は Quill の所へ行くけど、今は忙しい。まず Yusanu を探そう―兄貴なら…わかってくれる。たぶん。少なくとも Yulie よりはな。しばらく黙っててくれるって信じてる…わかるだろ？
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#389.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#389.dst: Yuman、まったく。こういう件でお前に先導させるなど、Yusanu も分かっているべきだ！何を考えていた？
Solidarity of Steel#389.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: おいおいおい！いきなり責め立てるなよ、兄貴！何があったんだ？
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: What gives? You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: 何があった？わかっているだろう―住居執行隊が丸ごと任務中に死んだんだ、静かに済むと思うか？
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: あー。それね。まあ、わかるだろ。いろいろあるもんさ、な？
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: お前…せめて真剣なふりくらいしろ。これが何を招くか、お前こそ一番わかっているはずだ。
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#394.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#394.dst: そ、それは―あ、あいつのせいじゃ、な、ないんだ、僕が―
Solidarity of Steel#394.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: おい、お姫様、いいんだ。俺をかばわなくていい、な？
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: で、どうするんだ、Yulie？いつもどおり会議か？
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: はあ…Quill が Aihan の件を片付け次第な。すぐ済むはずだから、皆もう集まっている。
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#399.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#399.dst: おい！外で何があった？みんな様子が変だぞ。
Solidarity of Steel#399.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: 助けに行ったじょ、女性を守るために、兵士とた、戦うことになって…
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: へえ。それだけか？もっとひどいことかと思った。
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: うん…ち、注目を集めるのをし、心配してるんだ…
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#404.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#404.dst: まだ厨房で夕食の手伝いです！ご心配なく、会議が終わったら私から伝えておきます。
Solidarity of Steel#404.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#405.dst: やあ、皆。遅くなってすまない。
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#406.dst: Aihan は…ここに残るのか？
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#407.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#407.dst: まだ決めかねているが、今夜は泊まることに同意してくれた。気の毒に、ひどく参っている。休めば少しは良くなるだろう。
Solidarity of Steel#407.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: だがそれが、この会議を開いた理由にもつながる。救出は…うまくいかなかったようだね？
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#409.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#409.dst: うまくいかない、どころではありません。軍は厳戒態勢です！今夜 {p} に出入りした全員が尋問された―トンネルを使わなければ、まだ列に並んでいたところです！
Solidarity of Steel#409.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: まさに大惨事です。Yuman、何か言うことはあるか？いい加減わかっているはずだ、我々は―
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#411.dst: ちょ、ちょっと！そ、それはあ、あいつのせいじゃない！ぼ、僕が―
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#412.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#412.dst: いや、責任は俺にある。俺がリーダーだったんだ、何が起きても俺の責任さ。もっと…強く止めるべきだった。
Solidarity of Steel#412.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: 僕がいればこんなことにはならなかった…くそ。最悪のタイミングだ。全部僕の―
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: よし、そこまで。みんなバカみたいだぞ！誰のせいかなんてどうでもいい。もう起きたことなんだから、どうするか考えよう。
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#416.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#416.dst: まだ終わってないぞ！兵士が何人か死んだくらいで世界の終わりみたいに。それが何だ？兵士なんていつも死んでる。
Solidarity of Steel#416.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: こんな死に方はしない。王家の目をかわせる余裕など我々にはないんだ！ここで何をしているか知られたら、我々は終わりだ。
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: でもまだ知られてないだろ？打つ手はまだある。例えば―あんたは探偵隊にいるんだろ！疑いが出たら、よそへ誘導すればいいじゃないか？
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: それに。隠れ続けるために、罪のない人が傷つくのを見て見ぬふりするなら―それのどこがレジスタンスだ？何の意味がある？
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: Rex…言葉に気をつけて。後で後悔するようなことは―
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#421.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#421.dst: 何の「意味」だと！？「意味」は、ここに「すでに」いる守るべき人々全員だ！Quill、頼む、味方してくれ。
Solidarity of Steel#421.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: …いや、Yulie、Rex の言うことにも一理ある。言い方はきつかったが…我々はこれまでずっと受け身だった。我々の安全のためとはいえ、人が傷つくのを許してきた。
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: 理由はあった…そして力の限り良い仕事もしてきた。だが行動を恐れていては、どうして物事が良い方へ変わるだろう？
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Quill
