Solidarity of Steel#425.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: 苛立つのは間違っていないよ、Yulie。私ももっと慎重に対処してほしかった…だが、こういうことはいずれ起きたのだ。これまでの苦難と同じく、今回も乗り越えられる。
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: …さて、少し空気を和ませよう！夕食ももうすぐだ。Yuman、今日新しい歌を作っていると言っていたね。今夜も演奏するかね？
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: へ？ああ、うん、うん！もちろん、やれるぜ。
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: ゴホン。解散の前に、よろしければ―皆が集まっている今、関連する情報を整理しておくと有益かと存じます。
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#430.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#430.dst: 私たちの多くは Roughworks に不慣れですから、土地の事情を知っておくと役立ちます。
Solidarity of Steel#430.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: そうね、もちろん。私も前から似たことを提案しようと思ってたの…この騒ぎの前にね。
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#432.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#432.dst: もちろん、いいとも！何が知りたいかね？
Solidarity of Steel#432.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: ああ、そうだ。彼女の名は Soosu。多くは語れん…かなりの引きこもりで、屋敷にこもって働き詰めだ。
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: その点では Zhiraok と正反対ね。できれば彼女の注意は引かないようにしたいわ。彼女まで加わったら心配の種が多すぎるもの。
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: それが一番だね。彼女は…いわば天才なんだ。一世紀以上前に、たった一人で産業時代をもたらしたんだよ！Fruma で見る機械のほとんどは、たぶん何らかの形で彼女に行き着く。
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: はは！さすが兄貴、よく知ってるな。オタクめ。
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: な―ただの歴史の記録だよ、Yuman。からかうなら、せめてちゃんとやってよ。
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#438.dst: 祝福はどうなんだ？もし出くわしたら、何に気をつければいいか知っておきたい。
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: 詳しくは知らん…だが、物質を意のままに形作れるのは確かだ。どの程度か、どんな限界があるかは…わからん。その不確かさこそ危険だ。気をつけなさい。
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: よろしい！では夕食にしよう。
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Sui と話し、Yuman の演奏を観る。

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: Yuman の演奏がもうすぐ始まるわ。Sui から何か食べる物をもらってきたら？
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: あ、{u}！ここではほとんど会えてない気がする…
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: 私、えっと…Mora から聞いたの。任務でのこと。あの女の人を助けられて…よかった。
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: 私、はは、その場にいて手伝えたらって思っちゃう。でも、私に何ができたかは…よくわからないけど。
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#446.dst: だ、だから、よかったのかも！私は、えっと、料理で忙しかったから。鋼の羽根のために。ここ、はは、人が多いの！
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#447.dst: でも新しいレシピを覚えたし、新しい人とも知り合えたよ！あ、そうだ、たぶん、えっと、ご飯をもらいに来たんだよね。はい！どうぞ。
Solidarity of Steel#447.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#448.dst: …あ、こんにちは！ご飯をもらいに？
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: あ、い、いえ、私―その、はい、ご飯は欲しいですけど、{u} に―お礼を言いに来たんです。
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: じ―自分を過小評価しないで！まだ…ぜ、全部はわからないけど、あんなふうに…衛兵と戦うのは危険で、だから―嫌がる人がいるのもわかるし…
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: でもあなたはやってくれて、そ―それが―すごく嬉しいんです。
Solidarity of Steel#451.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: えっと、本当にひどい状況だったみたいだね。だから無事に逃げられてよかった。
Solidarity of Steel#452.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: は、はは…ええ。前から…ご、強引ではあったけど、こんなに―こんなに―こんな、その、暴力的なのは初めてで。
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#454.dst: は、はい、そうです。ここは…新しくて、ち―違うけど、みんなとても親切で…
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: ちょっと―ちょっと不思議で…まるで―まるで―私にはもったいないみたい！だって、わ、わ、私はまだ…は、働いてないから。
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#456.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#456.dst: えっと…ここでの暮らしが、どんなものか、よくわからないけど…私のいた所では、人は助け合うの。生きる権利を稼がなきゃいけないなんて、おかしいよ。
Solidarity of Steel#456.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#457.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#457.dst: あ、あなたの故郷は、こ―ここよりずっといい所なんですね。
Solidarity of Steel#457.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#458.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: はは…今思うとば、ばかみたい。くだらない―く、くだらないノルマ…いたっ…
Solidarity of Steel#458.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: Oh, it- it's nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: あ、い―いえ、何でも。ただ、重いき、機械で。入った時に―肩を痛めて。わ、私のせいなんです、も、もっと気をつけるべきだった…
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#462.dst: えっと…わ、私、はは、治せるよ。
Solidarity of Steel#462.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#463.dst: え…本当に？ど、どうやって？
Solidarity of Steel#463.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: ただ…はあ。ついて来て、そして―信じて。
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: ちょ、ちょっと！わ、私このシャツしかなくて、む―無理―わ―
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#470.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#470.dst: どうやって―どうやったの？
Solidarity of Steel#470.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#471.dst: 私は…呪われてるの。だからよ。
Solidarity of Steel#471.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#473.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#473.dst: わ―あ、ありがとう。知らなかった…呪われし者も―優しくなれるなんて。
Solidarity of Steel#473.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#474.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#474.dst: えっと…も、もう行きます。ご飯と―それと―それと…肩を治してくれて、ありがとう。ほ、本当に感謝してます。
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: いいの。予想どおりだから。私…役に立ててよかった。
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#478.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#478.dst: そ、そうかもね！はは…少なくとも、えっと、怖がってはなかった。緊張してただけ。
Solidarity of Steel#478.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#479.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#479.dst: 私は、えっと、あとでみんなと合流するね。
Solidarity of Steel#479.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#480.dst: みんなの所へ行って。えっと、私もすぐ行くから。
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#481.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#481.dst: {u}、来てくれて嬉しいわ。夕食はもう食べた？
Solidarity of Steel#481.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#482.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#482.dst: 美味しいでしょう？Quill が言うには、あの子はここの料理人たちにすっかり溶け込んでるって。
Solidarity of Steel#482.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: それで、{u}、君も Yuman の演奏をま、待ってるの？
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: 彼の音楽の才能については評判を聞いております！ただ、その、曲の幅には、その、物足りなさがあるとも。
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#485.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#485.dst: ならご安心を、たった今思い出させてもらいましたからね、ほほ！
Solidarity of Steel#485.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#486.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#486.dst: なあ、もしかしたらお前の歌を書いたのかもな、Zeph！
Solidarity of Steel#486.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: な、な、何！？R、Rex、ち、違う、あ、あいつは…そんな、ち、違…な、なんであいつがそんな―
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: はは！落ち着けって、からかっただけさ。
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: ゴホン…注目、注目！皆、集まってくれ！
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: 今日はこんなに大勢が夕食に来てくれて嬉しく思う。これほど人が集まったのは久しぶりな気がするよ！
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#491.dst: もちろん伝えるべき知らせもある…だがまず！料理人たちに感謝を捧げよう。
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: Fletch の腕前は皆知っているが、今日の夕食は新たな仲間の助けなしにはできなかった。Sui だ！
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: わ…！そ、はは、その―えっと。大したことじゃないの。お、お手伝いできて光栄です！
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#494.dst: 照れなくていいんだよ、お嬢さん！
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: 夕食はさておき、お知らせに移ろう！
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#496.dst: 今日は一人ではなく、七人もの新しい仲間が来た！Sui に加え、Aihan、Mora、Rex、Zeph、{u}、Syndra を歓迎してくれ！
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: さて、王家の軍との…まあ「小競り合い」の噂はもう広まっているだろう。安心してほしい、すべて把握している！鋼の羽根は安全で、隠れたままだ。
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#498.dst: とはいえ、しばらくは駅の外への遠征の危険が高まる。志願者向けに、明朝新しい指針を用意しておく。
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#499.dst: 明るい知らせもあるぞ、切符売り場にキャンディバーとソーダを補充した！売り切れる前に交換するように―規則は一人一種類ずつだ。
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: さて！今この瞬間に驚きがなければ、本日の報告は以上だ。今日は自ら名乗り出てくれたので、舞台は Yuman に任せよう。
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#501.dst: 鋼の羽根のみんなー、ハロォォォォォ！
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: いつもどおり会えて嬉しいぜ―よう、Taio、決まってるな！Mei、その髪型最高！Jin、相棒！
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: えーと…じゃあ歌の紹介をしようかな。新曲なんだ！もう一曲しかないアーティストってからかえないぜ、はは！
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#504.dst: この曲はしばらく作ってたんだ。でも終わり方がずっと見つからなくて…今まではな。やっとインスピレーションが湧いたんだ。
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: さて、おしゃべりはここまで。いくぜ！
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#507.dst: ふふふん！誰かと思えば！
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#510.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#510.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#512.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#512.dst: 警備を少し差し引け。門を通るだけで二十分もかかるべきではない。話がある、一時間前にな。
Solidarity of Steel#512.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: わお、大口先生、あと数週間は来ないはずの人がずいぶん偉そうね！何事！？あたしのノリを邪魔しないでよ！
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equatio- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: 君の予定―Oru に習っているのか？この地方の緊急事態は君の憲章よりはるかに大きな値だ、君主、だから方程式に加算を―んっ。
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#515.dst: 予定を変えて早めに来たのは、離反者を追うためだ―Syndra と、その反乱分子どもをな。名前は聞いているだろう？
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#000~1.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but his enthusiasm gets the best of him sometimes.
Solidarity of Steel#000~1.dst: 兄弟たちがあまり迷惑をかけていないといいのですが。特に Yuman は…いい子なのですが、時々熱意が先走ってしまって。

Solidarity of Steel#001~1.src: My water's been out for two days now. Last bloke I tried to get on the job refused.
Solidarity of Steel#001~1.dst: もう二日も水が出ねえんだ。この前頼んだ奴には断られちまった。

Solidarity of Steel#002~1.src: These boards can last generations, you're sure of it. And this one is covered in notes of all kinds! Even graffiti carvings mean something. There's a carving in one corner that catches your eye...
Solidarity of Steel#002~1.dst: この板は何世代ももつ、それは間違いない。しかもこの板はあらゆるメモで埋め尽くされている！落書きの彫り跡にさえ意味がある。隅の彫り跡が目に留まった…

Solidarity of Steel#003~1.src: You made it back to Torann.

Solidarity of Steel#358~1.src: Grab that backpack and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#358~1.dst: そのリュックを取って…使えると思うものを選んで…
Solidarity of Steel#358~1.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#359~1.src: You've probably seen most of the station by now. Time to head back.
Solidarity of Steel#359~1.dst: 駅の大部分はもう見て回っただろう。そろそろ戻ろう。

Solidarity of Steel#458~1.src: We- no, no, no, this- this won't work, I can't- you need to pack different things, I can't go with- with this, pleas
Solidarity of Steel#458~1.dst: 私たち- だめ、だめ、だめ、これじゃ- これじゃだめ、無理- 別の物を詰めて、これじゃ- 行けない、お願

Solidarity of Steel#459~1.src: There's an inscription, but it's written in a language you can't understand.
Solidarity of Steel#459~1.dst: 碑文があるが、読めない言語で書かれている。

Solidarity of Steel#460~1.src: It's the poster you stuck on advertising the Pishlas Hot Springs.
Solidarity of Steel#460~1.dst: Pishlas 温泉を宣伝するために貼ったポスターだ。
